LanguageData.CC_Task_Msg_Set_4: {PAWN} takes up the council's business as its {OFFICE}: {KIND}, with {TARGET}.
LanguageData.CC_Task_Ans_WinOver_4: {NAME}'s answer runs longer than {PAWN}'s letter did, and ends with a question to keep the letters coming.
LanguageData.CC_Task_Ans_WinOver_5: {NAME} thanks {PAWN} for the letter and answers each thing in it in turn.
LanguageData.CC_Task_Ans_Trade_4: {NAME} writes that their traders have been asking about the colony's goods, and wants to know what it would take in return.
LanguageData.CC_Task_Ans_BringHome_3: {NAME} answers that {OURS} is unharmed, and that a price is being talked over among their people.
LanguageData.CC_Task_Ans_TheirKin_3: {NAME} thanks the colony for news of their kin, and writes that the families are gathering what they can to bring them home.
LanguageData.CC_Task_Ans_KeepFaith_3: {NAME} answers with a prayer of their own copied out at the end, for the colony's believers.
LanguageData.CC_Task_Ans_SpeakFaith_3: {NAME} writes that the colony's faith is mistaken, then fills a page with questions about it.
LanguageData.CC_Task_Ans_Host_3: {NAME} writes that their people have not sat at a feast away from home in a long time, and would be glad to come.
LanguageData.CC_Task_Ans_Moot_3: {NAME} answers, though what the letter was about was settled after it was sent.
LanguageData.CC_Task_Visit_Arrived_3: {PAWN} has reached {TOWN}, where they receive the colony's officer in their own way: {RITE}.
LanguageData.CC_Task_Visit_Arrived_4: At {TOWN}, {PAWN} is taken in and given a place for the day, as their people do it: {RITE}.
LanguageData.CC_Task_Patrol_Quiet_4: {PAWN} has walked the edges of {COLONY} at dawn. No smoke, and no tracks that shouldn't be there.
LanguageData.CC_Task_Patrol_Quiet_5: Back from the dawn walk, {PAWN} reports the edges of {COLONY} clear.
LanguageData.CC_Task_TradeOffer_3: {WHO} writes for {PEOPLE}: the colony has shown it can be trusted with a price, and they would like {KIND}, {RITE} as their ways ask.
LanguageData.CC_Task_TradeOffer_Won_2: {WHO} writes for {PEOPLE}: they count the colony among their friends now, and offer it {KIND}, {RITE} as their ways ask.
LanguageData.CC_Keeper_Watch_4: {PAWN} found the guests from {PEOPLE} still up after dark, and stayed near them a while.
LanguageData.CC_Keeper_Caught_Talk_3: {OTHER} stopped answering {PAWN}'s questions halfway through, and {NAME} will hear why. {NAME} thinks less of the colony, and of {PAWN} most of all.
LanguageData.CC_Keeper_Caught_Informer_3: {NAME} found out who was paying for word of them. It was {PAWN}, and {NAME} thinks less of the colony for it.
LanguageData.CC_Keeper_Caught_Visit_3: {PAWN} asked one question too many at their town, and it reached {NAME}. {NAME} thinks less of the colony, and of {PAWN} most of all.
LanguageData.CC_Keeper_Press_Yes_3: {NAME} will pay {SILVER} silver so that no one hears {NAME} {SECRET}, and wants nothing more to do with the colony.
LanguageData.CC_Keeper_Press_No_3: {NAME} would not pay, and the colony has told it as it said it would: {NAME} {SECRET}. {PEOPLE} hold the telling against the colony.
LanguageData.CC_Keeper_Ans_Moot_3: {NAME} answers only that there is nothing left to talk about.
LanguageData.CC_Keeper_Nothing_Talk_2: {PAWN} spent a long while with {OTHER} and came away knowing all about the roads and the weather, and nothing new about {NAME}.
LanguageData.CC_Keeper_Nothing_Talk_3: {OTHER} talked freely with {PAWN}, about everything but {NAME}.
LanguageData.CC_Keeper_Nothing_Informer_2: The informer took the silver and told {PAWN} what everyone already says about {NAME}.
LanguageData.CC_Keeper_Nothing_Informer_3: {PAWN} paid for word of {NAME} and got a story that fell apart on the second telling.
LanguageData.CC_Keeper_Nothing_Visit_2: {PAWN} asked careful questions all day at their town and heard nothing about {NAME} worth the road.
LanguageData.CC_Keeper_Nothing_Visit_3: At their town, {PAWN} found the people around {NAME} loyal, or careful, and came away with nothing.
